forms.reason: Outside the agreed Zygarde 10% collecting scope: the artwork shows Mega Zygarde and a Complete Forme outline, with no 10% dog Forme. This is a real card, not a nonexistent or false language release.

The 10% dog Forme appears as an outlined cameo at the lower left. Mega Zygarde is the printed primary, but that primary form is outside scope. Retain this physical card as a 10% cameo, not as a primary dog card.
